text.en:
Upon reaching 3 points with Weapon Kills:
Starts Health Regeneration and heals for ~80 HP

Rank-And-File Combatants give 1 point.
Guardians give 2 points.
Elites/Minibosses/Bosses give 3 points.

For Combatant Classifications, check out <link this link [https://d2clarity.page.link/combatant] />!

Weapon Kills must be within 5 seconds of each.

enhanced (
#e Heals for an additional 5HP upon reaching 3 points.
)
text.zh-chs:
武器连续击杀 3 名敌人时：
开始生命恢复，恢复总值约为 80。

普通敌人记为 1 个击杀。
守护者记为 2 个击杀。
精英、强大敌人、首领记为 3 个击杀。

可在 <link Court's Spreadsheet [https://d2clarity.page.link/combatant] /> 查询敌人分类

连续击杀敌人需在 5 秒内完成。

enhanced (
#e 3 个击杀时获得额外 5 点生命值恢复.
)

text.en:
Starts Health Regeneration and restores #e${80+#d} HP upon reaching 100% Activation Progress with Weapon Kills.

Activation Progress by Enemy Rank:
• Minor Combatants: 33.3%
• Players: 66.6%
• Majors and Bosses: 100%

Weapon Kills must be within 5 seconds of each.

enhanced (
var d = 5
#e Heals for an additional 5 HP.
)
